purpose: Define ownership as the explicit structural dimension that identifies which canonical identity owns a semantic fact or surface, separate from containment, authority and visibility.

topics.name: Ownership
topics.purpose: Define ownership as the explicit structural dimension that identifies which canonical identity owns a semantic fact or surface, separate from containment, authority and visibility.

semantics.single_owner_rule: A machine-significant semantic fact has one authoritative owner unless explicit reconciliation defines otherwise.
semantics.containment_rule: Containing an identity does not make the container semantic owner.
semantics.authority_rule: Semantic ownership does not automatically grant runtime/AccessCore authority.
semantics.projection_rule: Projection/view does not become owner of projected facts.
semantics.composition_rule: Consumer composition references owner semantics rather than copying them.
semantics.trace_rule: Ownership is preserved in provenance and reverse traces.

invariants.rule: Structural dimensions and registries remain explicit and are never collapsed into generic hierarchy.
